name: front
description: Reads Front Core REST API streams and exposes fixed, typed, approval-gated Front write/direct/binary operation metadata for documented API parity.

risk.read: external Front API reads for contacts, conversations, inboxes, tags, teammates, channels, events, knowledge base, analytics metadata, accounts, and related resources
risk.write: fixed Front API mutations declared as reverse ETL write actions with typed schemas and destructive confirmation
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; every Front write action also declares destructive confirmation in this bundle
